about: Plan 9 D28 design eval: 20 prompts across design-heavy, mixed and engineering-heavy builds. `expect` is the design class the classifier should give (tests/test_design_eval_set.py checks it). Not run in CI: run_eval.py builds each with a chosen model and renders a contact sheet; preference_sheet.py pairs two runs for the user's pairwise preference.

prompts.prompt: Design a sleek home humanoid robot, about 1.7 m, Optimus / NEO class: covered joints, no exposed servos, calm appliance-like look.
Build me a robotic dog about 70 cm long with covered legs and a clean body shell, like a friendly Spot.
Design a car body for a compact electric sedan: 2.7 m wheelbase, 17 inch wheels, sporty greenhouse.
Design a premium electric kettle, 1.2 litres, with a sculpted handle and a soft-touch base.
A minimalist desk lamp with a slim arm and a rounded head, Braun-like.
A portable bluetooth speaker with a fabric-wrapped body and a beautiful rounded top.
An ergonomic computer mouse shell for a right hand, 120 mm long.
Concept e-scooter with a flowing deck and covered battery, styled like a show car.
A robot vacuum with a sleek low body, 330 mm diameter, and a friendly look.
A wrist watch case, 40 mm, with elegant lugs and a domed crystal.
A 5 inch FPV drone frame with a printed canopy over the flight stack.
A jet engine nacelle and fan module for a 1:10 scale turbofan model, with the fan disk and compressor inside.
A 6-axis robot arm with covered links, 600 mm reach, 1 kg payload.
An enclosure for a Raspberry Pi 5 with a 30 mm fan and vents.
An injection mold for a 30 mm bottle cap with cooling channels and ejector pins.
An L bracket for a NEMA17 motor with four M3 holes, 5 mm thick, 50 N load.
A gearbox housing for a 10:1 planetary stage with bearing seats at 0.02 mm tolerance.
A heat sink for a TO-220 package, 40 x 40 mm, natural convection.
A drill jig for 6 holes on a 100 mm PCD flange.
A hydraulic manifold block with 4 ports at 200 bar pressure.
